name: Whitewashed and Bleached Hardwood Floors: How They're Done
title-tag: Whitewashed and Bleached Hardwood Floors: How It’s Done
meta-description: Whitewashing adds white pigment; bleaching removes the wood’s color. A Seattle-area contractor on species, cost, finish choice, and living with a pale floor.
post-summary: April 2, 2027 · Whitewashing adds white pigment to the grain; bleaching chemically strips the wood’s own color first. Which species cooperate, why red oak reads pink, why oil-based finish ruins a pale floor, and what a white floor is actually like in year five.
